title: ReleasesFile
description: content/releases.json: the release gate. Per exam profile, the subjects and chapters released to production. A production publish builds only these and needs every media item in them approved; everything else is skipped and listed in the publish report. The content check fails when a released subject or chapter is below 100% coverage (PRD 14). Staging and local builds publish everything.

profiles.description: Exam profile id -> what is released for it. A profile that is not listed has nothing released.

subjects.description: Whole subjects released: every chapter of the subject the exam map includes.

chapters.description: Single chapters released, for subjects that are not released whole.
